message: org1000.yaml:extends.crm.product_addons: table was removed from the graph; extension ignored

Tenant.description: One row per company. LLM JSON extracted from product / business PDFs.

User.description: Worktual account users used for Campaign login. Campaign reads this table only — it does not create or alter account users.

available_products.meaning: Products this team works on (JSON list).

Role.description: Named roles (admin, marketing, sales_manager, etc.) assigned to users via product access. Campaign uses role name in JWT and UI.

product_id.meaning: Which product this role is for.

BusinessHours.description: When the company / team is open.

timing_mode.meaning: same vs different hours per day.

Holiday.description: One holiday date on a calendar.

PhoneNumber.description: Phone numbers (DIDs) and where calls go.

product_id.meaning: Which Worktual product the file is for (crm, contact-center, …).

ccaas_audience.meaning: For Contact Center only: bot, agent_assist, or both.

Event.description: Time-series behavioral and commerce events for each customer.

channel.meaning: Web, mobile, email, store, API, etc.

page_path.meaning: Page or route where the event occurred.

occurred_at.meaning: Business occurrence time and partition key.

reference_id.meaning: Related order, product, campaign, or external ID.

Session.description: Persistent draft workspace for AI agent modules (create-campaign, contacts, monitoring). Large JSON payload holds chat, wizard stage, and in-progress campaign state.

stage.meaning: Wizard stage: intake, audience, templates, launch_plan.

ContactInsight.description: Human-readable AI-generated or deterministic customer insights.

NextBestAction.description: Customer-specific recommended actions, content, products, or timings.

Persona.description: Versioned organization-level buyer persona archetypes shared by customers.

Purchase.description: Customer orders and order-level commerce facts.

ContactCentreAgent.description: Description: Current presence state for each agent (ready, busy, offline, etc.) used by routing and supervisor views.

status.meaning: Legacy simplified presence used by older routing paths.

presence_state.meaning: Enterprise presence state (offline, ready, busy, not_ready, after_contact_work).

source.meaning: Origin system or actor that created the record.

Skill.description: Description: Skill catalog used for skill-based routing and queue requirements.

is_active.meaning: Soft-active flag; inactive rows are hidden from pickers.

ContactCentreQueue.description: Description: NLP/routing metadata for a queue: intents, keywords, example phrases, and skill mapping.

supported_intents.meaning: JSON array of intents this queue handles.

example_phrases.meaning: JSON array of routing classifier example phrases.

language_codes.meaning: JSON array of supported ISO language codes.

ContactCentreSLA.description: Description: SLA policy definitions (thresholds, warning percentages) referenced by queues.

is_active.meaning: Soft-active flag; inactive rows are hidden from pickers.

Conversation.description: Description: Persisted NLP/context memory snippets associated with a conversation.

InternalNote.description: Description: Agent notes attached to a conversation (customer-visible or internal).

conversation_id.meaning: Parent conversation this row belongs to.

body.meaning: Primary text content (message body, note text, etc.).

Transfer.description: Description: Warm/blind transfer requests between queues or agents with state tracking.

conversation_id.meaning: Parent conversation this row belongs to.

offered_at.meaning: Timestamp when an offer was presented to an agent.

accepted_at.meaning: Timestamp when an offer or transfer was accepted.

completed_at.meaning: Timestamp when the task was completed.

Task.description: Description: Agent task inbox items (callbacks, follow-ups, co-worker suggestions) linked to contacts/conversations.

assigned_user_id.meaning: Platform user id of the assigned agent.

assigned_by_label.meaning: Display label for who assigned the task.

contact_id.meaning: Canonical customer contact in cdp.contacts when linked.

conversation_id.meaning: Parent conversation this row belongs to.

task_type.meaning: Task category: follow_up, callback, escalation, suggestion.

status.meaning: Domain-specific status enum for this entity.

priority.meaning: Relative priority (higher = more urgent where applicable).

channel.meaning: Omnichannel identifier (webchat, email, whatsapp, instagram, facebook, voice).

due_at.meaning: Task due date/time for agent inbox sorting.

completed_at.meaning: Timestamp when the task was completed.

dismissed_at.meaning: Timestamp when the task was dismissed.

Product.description: Shared product catalog (all business types). CRM does DML only — no DDL on inventory.

Account.description: B2B accounts / franchise entities within a tenant. Required for B2B deals; optional for B2B2C contacts.

id.meaning: Referenced by deals, contacts, orders, invoices, contracts

SalesProfile.description: CRM overlay on a CDP person — lifecycle, ownership, BANT, nurture/lifecycle agent state. Not the person identity store.

Deal.description: B2B opportunity record. Stages: qualification → discover → propose → negotiate → closed_won / closed_lost.

DealActivity.description: Tasks/calls/meetings logged on a deal (not the contact timeline).

ContactActivity.description: Unified contact timeline — emails, meetings, tasks, notes. Powers Inbox and activity feed.

Quote.description: Formal quotation on a deal; may originate from a proposal.

SalesOrder.description: Confirmed order — from accepted quote (B2B) or direct commerce (B2C: deal_id null, contact_id set).

Contract.description: Subscription/ARR record created on closed-won; drives renewal reminders.

SalesRep.description: Per-rep capacity overlay for assignment agent.

PrivacyRequest.description: GDPR-style deletion/access requests — human must execute.

SupportAgent.description: Thin staff bridge. Local id is used by tickets/sessions/notes. Identity (name, email, password, skills) lives in accounts.setup_users via setup_user_id. Never INSERT into MyAccount from Ticketing.

support_email.meaning: Optional spoke email copy for mail

SupportCompany.description: B2B client accounts inside Ticketing (companies your end-customers belong to). Not MyAccount accounts.*.

SupportQueue.description: Support teams / queues used for routing and workload.

Ticket.description: Core support cases (the main work item).

SupportSLA.description: Per-org SLA windows by priority (what actually drives tickets.due_at).

Note.description: Conversation thread on a ticket (public replies + internal notes).

KnowledgeArticle.description: Knowledge-base articles for help center / agent assist.

AuditEvent.description: Append-only compliance audit trail of important mutations.

InboundEmail.description: Maps inbound email Message-ID → ticket for threading.

OutboundEmail.description: Log of outbound emails (customer, staff, SLA).

Approval.description: Human-in-the-loop approvals for proactive tool actions.

Campaign.description: Central persisted campaign record after the create-campaign agent saves or launches. Holds name, goal, audience snapshot, schedule, and per-channel run metrics in JSON.

status.meaning: Lifecycle: draft, scheduled, live, completed, cancelled.

session_id.meaning: Agent session this campaign was saved from (unique).

MessageTemplate.description: Per-channel message template drafts within an agent session. fields JSON holds structured content (email blocks, push title/body, etc.) for the frontend editor.

Delivery.description: One row per recipient per send attempt. Tracks delivery status, ESP message id, A/B variant, and open/click engagement counters for reporting.

status.meaning: Delivery status: pending, sent, failed, skipped.

ab_variant.meaning: A/B bucket: a, b, holdout, winner.

EmailEngagement.description: Campaign-scoped email engagement and unsubscribe state for a CDP contact. Aggregates opens/clicks at contact level across campaigns for consent checks.
